title: Star Wars Sounds Came From a Bear and an Old TV 🎬 #shorts
description:
Guess: which Star Wars sound came from a hammer? Comment 1, 2 or 3.

Sound designer Ben Burtt recorded real things for the 1977 film: the lightsaber hum is a film projector motor mixed with TV buzz, Chewbacca is mostly a young bear plus other animals, the TIE fighter scream is a changed elephant call, R2-D2 is half synthesizer and half Burtt's own voice, and the blaster is a hammer hitting a radio tower's steel guy wire.

Sources: NPR (Ben Burtt interview, 2010), Designing Sound (Ben Burtt special, 2009), filmsound.org, Vice (2014)
